verdict.rationale: Trello is a SaaS product with AI features (e.g. AI-assisted writing), so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any privacy control that keeps customer data out of model training. The AI-writing mention and the MCP server listing say nothing about how training data is handled.
